title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 9 (Logan Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Logan Lake
9 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of Logan Lake, KDYD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Those waters of Logan Lake to the maximum high water mark.
